name: jarvis
title_zh: 桌面总管：一眼看穿所有 Agent 的花销与进度
tagline_zh: 受够了切来切去看不清哪个 Agent 在烧钱？Jarvis 把每个 Agent 的 token、费用。
tagline_en: Tired of juggling agents and surprise bills? Jarvis shows every agent's tokens, cost & status, delegates to.
desc_en: Chief of staff on an Omarchy desktop: see every agent, its tokens and cost, delegate work to bigger models (API, OAuth, Modal GPU endpoints), read results, stop or remove agents.
why_zh: 它不是又一个跑任务的 Agent，而是站在所有 Agent 头顶的调度台：实时监控 token 与花费…
why_en: Not another task-runner—it's the control tower above all agents: live token & cost tracking, offload heavy work via.
limit_zh: 只适用于 Omarchy 桌面环境，且需已安装并运行多个 Agent；不负责 Agent 内部的任务质量，只管监控。
limit_en: Omarchy desktop only, with multiple agents already running; doesn't judge task quality—just monitors, delegates, and retrieves; useless outside.
title_en: Desktop chief of staff: oversee agents, tokens & costs
